(formerly known as '''Bajaj Corp Ltd.''') is an [[India|Indian]] company that manufactures and markets personal care products, primarily in the hair care segment. It is a part of the [[Bajaj Group]], a business conglomerate founded in 1926.{{cite web | last=Tiwari | first=Shivani | title=Bajaj Consumer Share Buyback: Check price and important dates | website=Zee Business | date=2022-12-20 | url=https://www.zeebiz.com/market-news/news-bajaj-consumer-share-price-nse-buyback-date-2022-history-target-latest-news-213567 | access-date=2025-05-01}} == History == It is a subsidiary of the [[Bajaj Group]], which was established by [[Jamnalal Bajaj]]. The Bajaj Group is involved in industries such as sugar, consumer goods, power generation, and infrastructure development. In 1953, Kamalnayan Bajaj established Bajaj Sevashram to market and sell hair oils and other beauty products.{{Cite web |title=BAJAJ CONSUMER CARE LTD. (BAJAJCON) - COMPANY HISTORY |url=https://www.business-standard.com/company/bajaj-consumer-38716/information/company-history}} The Neilsen Retail Audit report indicates that Bajaj Almond Hair Oil holds a 52% market share in the light hair oil category.{{Cite web |url=http://www.majorgainz.com/market/pdfipo/RHP_BAJAJCO.pdf |title=Archived copy |access-date=9 November 2011 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120425152322/http://www.majorgainz.com/market/pdfipo/RHP_BAJAJCO.pdf |archive-date=25 April 2012 |url-status=dead }} In August 2013, Bajaj Consumer Care acquired the skincare brand NOMARKS.{{cite web|url=http://profit.ndtv.com/news/corporates/article-bajaj-corp-acquires-nomarks-brand-from-ozone-ayurvedics-326135 |title=Bajaj Corp acquires Nomarks brand from Ozone Ayurvedics - NDTVProfit.com |publisher=Profit.ndtv.com |date=2013-08-22 |accessdate=2013-12-16}} In July 2020, the company appointed Jaideep Nandi as managing director, succeeding Sumit Malhotra, who was stepped down on June 30.{{cite web | last=Martins | first=Maverick | title=Bajaj Consumer Care names Jaideep Nandi as new managing director | website=FashionNetwork.com | date=2020-06-19 | url=https://in.fashionnetwork.com/news/Bajaj-consumer-care-names-jaideep-nandi-as-new-managing-director,1225020.html | access-date=2025-05-01}} In February 2025, Bajaj Consumer Care acquired Hyderabad-based Vishal Personal Care Pvt. Ltd. for ₹120 crore.{{cite web | last=Tandon | first=Suneera | title=Bajaj Consumer Care to acquire Vishal Personal Care for ₹120 crore | website=mint | date=2025-02-15 | url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/bajaj-consumer-care-vishal-personal-care-fmcg-banjaras-brand-bajaj-group-peepul-capital-11739610357238.html | access-date=2025-05-01}} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== * {{Official website|https://www.bajajconsumercare.com}} {{Bajaj Group}} [[Category:Indian brands]] [[Category:Cosmetics brands]] [[Category:Chemical companies based in Mumbai]] [[Category:Cosmetics companies of India]] [[Category:Chemical companies established in 1930]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1930]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Bajaj Group]]
